messages.subject: Month-end reminder: time entry and WIP by COP Friday
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that January time needs to be entered and released by close of play this Friday so we can run the month-end WIP and billing. Several matters are showing unposted time. If you have any write-offs to flag on active matters, please let me know before the billing run.

Thanks,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
